crossRefs.note: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that…
Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope;
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the…
But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like…
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

translations.web: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
translations.bsb: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
translations.kjv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
translations.asv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; My flesh also shall dwell in safety.
